# FACET Verify — Due Diligence & Investigative Intelligence
> India's Best Due Diligence Company & Investigative Intelligence Firm for Corporate, Property, M&A, and Institutional Risk Verification.

FACET Verify (Fraud Analysis, Credibility & Estate Title) combines structured public-record verification, archival search, on-the-ground intelligence, and forensic research to deliver institutional-grade due diligence across India and key cross-border corridors (United States, United Kingdom, and Europe). Headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, FACET supports leading private equity funds, institutional lenders, corporate M&A teams, family offices, and legal counsels before high-stakes capital allocation.

## Key Service Pillars & Core Offerings

### 1. Property & Real Estate Due Diligence (Flagship)
- **URL**: https://www.facetverify.com/services/property-due-diligence
- **Coverage**: 30-year chronological deed search, Encumbrance Certificates (EC) cross-checked via Sub-Registrar Offices and CERSAI, mutation registers (Record of Rights / Pahani / 7/12 / Jamabandi / Patta).
- **Promoter & Seller Scrutiny**: Identity verification, PAN/DIN cross-reference, corporate directorships, NCLT insolvency scans, and e-Courts litigation search.
- **Physical & Technical Checks**: Zoning master plans, conversion orders (Agricultural to Non-Agricultural / NA), municipal sanctions (Commencement Certificate CC, Occupancy Certificate OC), and site boundary inspection.

### 2. Litigation, Legal & Regulatory Due Diligence
- **URL**: https://www.facetverify.com/services/litigation-regulatory-due-diligence
- **Coverage**: Multi-jurisdiction court docket search across District Courts (e-Courts), 25 High Courts, and the Supreme Court of India.
- **Specialized Tribunals**: National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT / IBC), Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT / DRAT), Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA), and Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions.
- **Regulatory Scrutiny**: Enforcement Directorate (ED), Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), SEBI debarment orders, and RBI Willful Defaulters lists.

### 3. Vendor & Third-Party Due Diligence
- **URL**: https://www.facetverify.com/services/vendor-third-party-due-diligence
- **Coverage**: Supply-chain integrity, statutory tax compliance (GSTIN, MCA21), Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) identification, circular vendor networks, and anti-bribery / FCPA / UK Bribery Act compliance.

### 4. Fraud & Corporate Investigative Intelligence
- **URL**: https://www.facetverify.com/services/fraud-investigative-intelligence
- **Coverage**: Internal fraud analysis, whistleblower allegation corroboration, asset diversion, conflict of interest, undisclosed related-party transactions, and shell entity mapping.

### 5. Asset & Ownership Intelligence
- **URL**: https://www.facetverify.com/services/asset-ownership-intelligence
- **Coverage**: Asset tracing, promoter personal guarantee evaluation, unencumbered real estate identification, corporate shareholding trees, and recovery intelligence for institutional lenders and creditors.

---

## Authoritative Indian Public Record Databases Inspected
FACET Verify queries and corroborates primary statutory registers:
- **Corporate**: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA21), ROC registers, Director Identification Number (DIN) dockets, CIBIL / RBI Wilful Defaulter lists.
- **Judicial**: e-Courts National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG), High Court dockets, Supreme Court of India, NCLT cause lists, DRT registries, RERA tribunals.
- **Land & Revenue**: State Inspector General of Registration (IGR), Bhoomi / Kaveri 2.0 (Karnataka), Mahabhulekh (Maharashtra), Meebhoomi / Dharani (Telangana/AP), Banglarbhumi (West Bengal), CERSAI national registry.
